IQMolX: IQmol with xtb calculations (see the README for what is new).

**macOS** (`IQMolX-<version>-macOS-arm64.dmg`): Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or later), macOS 14 or newer. Open the disk image and drag IQMolX to Applications. The app is not notarized by Apple: on first start right-click it and choose Open, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/IQMolX.app`.

**Windows** (`IQMolX-<version>-windows-x64.zip`, experimental): Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel/AMD. Unzip it and run `IQMolX\bin\IQMolX.exe`. Windows will warn about an unknown publisher: choose More info, then Run anyway. This build compiles and starts in tests on GitHub's machines but has had little testing on real Windows computers, so please report problems.
